Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.runner.json.parsing

Class SchemaManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.runner.json.parsing.SchemaManager
@Component public class SchemaManager extends Object
Manages JSON schema loading, caching, and validation for the Brobot configuration system.

This class provides centralized schema management for validating JSON configurations against predefined schemas. It supports JSON Schema draft v7 and provides efficient caching to avoid repeated schema loading from resources.

Key features:

  • Schema caching - Schemas are loaded once and cached for performance
  • Multiple schema support - Manages different schemas for various config types
  • Validation utilities - Provides both boolean and detailed error validation
  • Resource-based loading - Schemas are loaded from classpath resources

Supported schemas:

  • Project schema - Validates project configuration structure
  • Automation DSL schema - Validates automation workflow definitions

  • Method Details

    • getSchema

      public com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema getSchema(String schemaPath) throws ConfigurationException
      Retrieves a JSON schema from cache or loads it from resources.

      This method implements lazy loading with caching. The first request for a schema triggers loading from the classpath, and subsequent requests return the cached instance.

      Parameters:
      schemaPath - The classpath path to the schema resource (e.g., "/schemas/project-schema.json")
      Returns:
      The loaded JsonSchema instance
      Throws:
      ConfigurationException - if the schema cannot be loaded or is invalid

    • validate

      public Set<com.networknt.schema.ValidationMessage> validate(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode json, String schemaPath) throws ConfigurationException
      Validates a JSON node against a specified schema.

      This method returns the complete set of validation messages, allowing callers to inspect all validation errors in detail. An empty set indicates valid JSON.

      Parameters:
      json - The JSON node to validate
      schemaPath - The classpath path to the schema to validate against
      Returns:
      A set of validation messages; empty if validation passes
      Throws:
      ConfigurationException - if the schema cannot be loaded

    • isValid

      public boolean isValid(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode json, String schemaPath) throws ConfigurationException
      Checks if a JSON node is valid according to a specified schema.

      This is a convenience method that returns a simple boolean result. Use validate(JsonNode, String) for detailed error information.

      Parameters:
      json - The JSON node to validate
      schemaPath - The classpath path to the schema to validate against
      Returns:
      true if the JSON is valid, false otherwise
      Throws:
      ConfigurationException - if the schema cannot be loaded

    • validateWithErrors

      public void validateWithErrors(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode json, String schemaPath, String configName) throws ConfigurationException
      Validates JSON and throws an exception with detailed error messages if validation fails.

      This method is useful when you want validation to halt execution on failure. All validation errors are collected into a single, formatted error message for clear problem identification.

      Parameters:
      json - The JSON node to validate
      schemaPath - The classpath path to the schema to validate against
      configName - A descriptive name for the configuration being validated (used in error messages)
      Throws:
      ConfigurationException - containing all validation errors if validation fails

    • clearCache

      public void clearCache()
      Clears the schema cache, forcing schemas to be reloaded on next access.

      This method is useful during development or when schemas may have changed. In production, schemas are typically static and clearing the cache is unnecessary.

    • getProjectSchema

      public com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema getProjectSchema() throws ConfigurationException
      Retrieves the project configuration schema.

      The project schema defines the structure for project-level configurations including metadata, dependencies, and project settings.

      Returns:
      The project configuration JsonSchema
      Throws:
      ConfigurationException - if the schema cannot be loaded

    • getAutomationDslSchema

      public com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema getAutomationDslSchema() throws ConfigurationException
      Retrieves the automation DSL (Domain Specific Language) schema.

      The automation DSL schema defines the structure for automation workflows, including states, transitions, actions, and other automation primitives.

      Returns:
      The automation DSL JsonSchema
      Throws:
      ConfigurationException - if the schema cannot be loaded
